title: Item: Lamorna's Coal Charms
content:
Lamorna's Coal Charms

Coals cool down to become small palm-sized stone charms that could be added to jewelry or just pocketed. Must be touched with a free hand in order to activate.

  • Lamorna's Radiant Charge

  • As part of your Move, move an extra amount up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. The next Attack you make deals +4 radiant damage.

  • Once used three times, this Charm vanishes.


  • Lamorna's Legendary Resistance

  • If you fail a saving throw, you can choose to succeed instead.

  • Once used three times, this Charm vanishes.


  • Lamorna's Shimmering Shield

  • Target yourself or one creature you can see within 60 feet. Target gains 3d6 Temporary Hit Points, and its AC increases by 2 until the end of your next turn.

  • Once used three times, this Charm vanishes.


  • Lamorna's Magic Resistance

  • Gain Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects until the end of your next turn.


  • Lamorna's Calm Emotions

  • See normal spell.

  • Once used three times, this Charm vanishes.


  • Lamorna's Dispel Evil and Good

  • See normal spell. Only cast at it's normal lowest spell level version.

  • Once used three times, this Charm vanishes.


  • Lamorna's Entangle

  • See normal spell. Only cast at it's normal lowest spell level version.

  • Once used three times, this Charm vanishes.


  • Lamorna's Pass without Trace

  • See normal spell. Only cast at it's normal lowest spell level version.

  • Once used three times, this Charm vanishes.


  • Lamorna's Word of Recall

  • See normal spell. Only cast at it's normal lowest spell level version.

  • Once used three times, this Charm vanishes.


  • Lamorna's Detect Evil and Good

  • See normal spell. Only cast at it's normal lowest spell level version.

  • Once used three times, this Charm vanishes.


  • X3 Lamorna's Lesser Restoration

  • See normal spell. Only cast at it's normal lowest spell level version.

  • Once used three times, this Charm vanishes.


  • X3 Lamorna's Cure Wounds

  • See normal spell. Only cast at it's normal lowest spell level version.

  • Once used three times, this Charm vanishes.
